gaps.what: Second प्रत्यय (in प्रत्ययलक्षणम्) not explained: only the operation conditioned by the suffix as a suffix survives, not one conditioned by its sounds.
gaps.proposed_text: Why प्रत्ययलक्षणम्? Only what the suffix causes AS a suffix survives, not what its sounds cause: रैकुलम्, गोहितम् — no आय्/अव् (वर्णाश्रयत्वात्).

quote.quote: प्रत्ययलक्षणमिति किम्? रायः कुलं रैकुलम्। गवे हितं गोहितम्।

gaps.what: Restating प्रत्यय (already in force) means the WHOLE suffix must be elided; partial elision does not count.
gaps.proposed_text: Why repeat प्रत्यय-? The whole suffix must be gone: in आघ्नीय only the स् of सीयुट् is dropped (7.2.79), so 6.4.37 does not apply by 1.1.62.

quote.quote: कृत्स्नप्रत्ययलोपे यथा स्यात्। इह मा भूत् — आघ्नीय।

gaps.what: The next sūtra 1.1.63 न लुमताङ्गस्य restricts this one: after elision by लुक्/श्लु/लुप्, aṅga operations conditioned by the suffix do not take place.
gaps.proposed_text: Read with 1.1.63 न लुमताङ्गस्य: if the suffix was dropped by लुक्/श्लु/लुप्, the aṅga does NOT get the suffix-conditioned operation (गर्गाः, मृष्टः — no guṇa/vṛddhi).

quote.quote: लुमता शब्देन लुप्ते प्रत्यये यदङ्गम्, तस्य प्रत्ययलक्षणं कार्यं न भवति।

gaps.what: One example shows the rule at work: pada-saṃjñā survives the dropped सुप्/तिङ्.
gaps.proposed_text: Example: अग्निचित्, सोमसुत् — the सुप् is dropped, yet the word is still a pada (1.4.14).

quote.quote: अग्निचित्, सोमसुत्, अधोगित्यत्र सुप्तिङोर्लुप्तयोः <<सुप्तिङन्तं पदम्>> [[१.४.१४]] इति पदसंज्ञा भवति।

1.1.62.ok: Clear class-style vṛtti; prakāra of लोप linked to 1.1.60.

gaps.what: Why सिच् is restated: to cut off लिङ् carried from 1.2.13 (and stop it running on).
gaps.proposed_text: Why सिच्? 1.2.13 had लिङ्सिचौ; naming सिच् alone drops लिङ्: only the सिच् of हन् is kit (आहत, आहसाताम्).

quote.quote: सिज्ग्रहणं लिङ्निवृत्त्यर्थम्, उत्तरत्रानुवृत्तिर्मा भूत्।

gaps.what: Why ātmanepada only: in parasmaipada हन् is replaced by वध (2.4.43), so kit-ness would have no use there.
gaps.proposed_text: आत्मनेपदेषु is carried for the next rules; in parasmaipada हन् becomes वध anyway (2.4.43), so kit there would do nothing.

quote.quote: इह तु परस्मैपदे हन्तेर्वधभावस्य नित्यत्वात् कित्त्वस्य प्रयोजनं नास्ति॥

gaps.what: Purpose of kit-ness: न् drops by 6.4.37.
gaps.proposed_text: Example: आ+हन्+सिच्+त → आहत: being kit, सिच् lets the न् drop (6.4.37).

1.2.14.ok: Anuvṛtti of कित् and आत्मनेपदेषु correctly shown and carded.

gaps.what: प्रतिज्ञाने's job (counter-example) and its meaning (अभ्युपगम, affirming) are not taught.
gaps.proposed_text: प्रतिज्ञान = affirming/asserting (अभ्युपगमः): शब्दं नित्यं संगिरते. Not in that sense → parasmaipada: संगिरति ग्रासम् ‘swallows’.

quote.quote: प्रतिज्ञानमभ्युपगमः। शतं संगिरते। नित्यं शब्दं संगिरते। प्रतिज्ञाने इति किम्? संगिरति ग्रासम्॥

gaps.what: Page names the dhātu “गृ”; the carried ग्रः is गॄ निगरणे (tudādi, गिरति), not गॄ शब्दे (kryādi).
gaps.proposed_text: ग्रः = गॄ निगरणे (tudādi, गिरति), not गॄ शब्दे (kryādi): write ‘गॄ-धातोः (गिरतेः)’.

quote.quote: <<गॄ निगरणे>> (धा० पा० १४१०) इति तुदादौ पठ्यते, तस्येदं ग्रहणम्

gaps.what: These ātmanepada rules are exceptions to the default parasmaipada 1.3.78.
gaps.proposed_text: This overrides the default 1.3.78 शेषात् कर्तरि परस्मैपदम् — गॄ would otherwise take parasmaipada.

1.3.52.ok: Anuvṛtti of ग्रः and आत्मनेपदम् correctly carried; प्रतिज्ञाने carded as a meaning.

gaps.what: What कारक means (cause/means of the action) is not taught; the page only says ‘heading’.
gaps.proposed_text: कारक = what brings about the action (क्रियायाः हेतुः). Every saṃjñā 1.4.24–1.4.55 (अपादान …) is given only to such a participant.

quote.quote: कारकशब्दश्च निमित्तपर्यायः। कारकं हेतुरित्यनर्थान्तरम्। कस्य हेतुः? क्रियायाः।

gaps.what: Why the heading is needed (counter-example): a non-participant gets no kāraka name.
gaps.proposed_text: Why कारके? वृक्षस्य पर्णं पतति — the tree is only related, not a participant in the falling, so no अपादान; माणवकस्य पितरं पृच्छति — no कर्म.

quote.quote: कारक इति किम्? वृक्षस्य पर्णं पतति।

gaps.what: Bhāṣya: कारक is a long (महती) name, so it is meaningful (anvartha).
gaps.proposed_text: A long name like कारक is chosen to be meaningful (अन्वर्थसंज्ञा): only what DOES (साधक) the action is a कारक.

quote.quote: कारक इति महती संज्ञा क्रियते

1.4.23.ok: Correctly identifies the sūtra as an adhikāra.

gaps.what: Page says श्रेण्यादयः and कृतादिभिः ‘pair up in order (यथासङ्ख्यम्)’. They are gaṇas: any member compounds with any member (Kāśikā: एककृताः).
gaps.proposed_text: No yathāsaṅkhya here: श्रेण्यादि and कृतादि are word-lists; any member joins any (श्रेणिकृताः, एककृताः).

quote.quote: अश्रेणयः श्रेणयः कृताः, श्रेणिकृताः। एककृताः।

gaps.what: Vārttika 1 restricts the rule to the च्वि-sense (what was not X is made X).
gaps.proposed_text: Vārttika: only in the च्वि sense — ‘made into what they were not’: अश्रेणयः श्रेणयः कृताः = श्रेणिकृताः. With च्वि itself (श्रेणीकृताः) 2.2.18 compounds, nitya.

quote.quote: श्रेण्यादिषु च्व्यर्थग्रहणं कर्तव्यम्। अश्रेणयः श्रेणयः कृताः श्रेणिकृताः। यदा हि श्रेणय एव किञ्ञ्चित् क्रियन्ते तदा मा भूदिति

gaps.what: The two gaṇas are not listed; कृतादि is an ākṛtigaṇa (open list).
gaps.proposed_text: श्रेण्यादि: श्रेणि, एक, पूग, कुण्ड, राशि … (closed list). कृतादि: कृत, मित, मत, भूत, उक्त … — an open list (आकृतिगण).

quote.quote: श्रेण्यादयः पठ्यन्ते। कृतादिराकृतिगणः।

gaps.what: Vṛtti lacks the verb: reads ‘… सह विभाषा तत्पुरुषः इति संज्ञा समासः इति संज्ञा भवति’; Kāśikā: ‘सह समस्यन्ते, तत्पुरुषश्च समासो भवति’. Card ‘कस्य स्थाने?’ for श्रेण्यादयः is also wrong (nothing is replaced).
gaps.proposed_text: Vṛtti: ‘… कृतादिभिः समानाधिकरणैः सह विभाषा समस्यन्ते, तत्पुरुषश्च समासो भवति’. Card question: ‘which words are compounded?’ not ‘what is replaced?’.

quote.quote: श्रेण्यादयः सुबन्ताः कृतादिभिः समानाधिकरणैः सह समस्यन्ते, तत्पुरुषश्च समासो भवति॥

2.1.59.ok: Anuvṛtti of समानाधिकरणेन, विभाषा, तत्पुरुषः, समासः carried and carded.

gaps.what: Why भावेन: the marker must be an action, not a property.
gaps.proposed_text: Why भावेन? The marker must be an ACTION: गोषु दुह्यमानासु गतः. A mere attribute does not count: यो जटाभिः, स भुङ्क्ते — no 7th.

quote.quote: भावेनेति किम्? यो जटाभिः, स भुङ्क्ते।

gaps.what: Why भाव- again in भावलक्षणम्: what is marked must also be an action.
gaps.proposed_text: Why भाव- again in भावलक्षणम्? What is marked must be an action too: यो भुङ्क्ते, स देवदत्तः — the person is identified, not an action, so no 7th.

quote.quote: पुनर्भावग्रहणं किम्? यो भुङ्क्ते, स देवदत्तः॥

gaps.what: Card ‘कस्मिन् परे? / when what follows?’ for भावलक्षणम्. It names the other action that is marked, not a following element.
gaps.proposed_text: भावलक्षणम् = the other action marked by this one (क्रियान्तरं लक्ष्यते), not ‘what follows’. Card question: ‘what is marked?’

quote.quote: यस्य च क्रियया क्रियान्तरं लक्ष्यते, ततो भाववतः सप्तमी विभक्तिर्भवति।

gaps.what: Vārttika (SK) on the worthy/unworthy as agents: सत्सु तरत्सु असन्त आसते.
gaps.proposed_text: Vārttika: also when the worthy act and the unworthy do not (and the reverse): सत्सु तरत्सु असन्त आसते.

quote.quote: सत्सु तरत्सु असन्त आसते ।

gaps.what: One example makes the rule concrete.
gaps.proposed_text: Example: गोषु दुह्यमानासु गतः ‘he left while the cows were being milked’ — the milking marks the time of going.

quote.quote: गोषु दुह्यमानासु गतः।

2.3.37.ok: Vṛtti matches the Kāśikā; सप्तमी anuvṛtti shown.

gaps.what: Vārttika इण्वदिकः (Bhāṣya): इक् (अधि+इ ‘study’) gets गमि too.
gaps.proposed_text: Vārttika इण्वदिकः: इक् (with अधि, ‘to study’) also gets गमि before सन्: अधिजिगमिषति.

quote.quote: सनि च इण्वदिक इत्येव। अधिजिगमिषति।

gaps.what: Counter-example for the carried अबोधने: in the sense ‘to know’ no गमि.
gaps.proposed_text: अबोधने: in the sense ‘to understand’ इण् stays: अर्थान् प्रतीषिषति. Otherwise जिगमिषति.

quote.quote: अबोधन इत्येव — अर्थान् प्रतीषिषति।

gaps.what: Why a separate sūtra (yogavibhāga): so 2.4.48 इङश्च applies only before सन्.
gaps.proposed_text: Stated separately from 2.4.46 so that the next rule, 2.4.48 इङश्च, applies before सन् only.

quote.quote: योगविभाग उत्तरार्थः। <<इङश्च>> [[२.४.४८]] इति सन्येव यथा स्यात्॥

2.4.47.ok: Every carried word (इणः, अबोधने, गमिः, आर्धधातुके) shown with its source.

gaps.what: These forms are allowed in ordinary language (भाषायाम्), unlike the Vedic क्वसु/कानच् of 3.2.105–107. Page doesn't say so.
gaps.proposed_text: Unlike the Vedic लिट्/क्वसु/कानच् (3.2.105–107), these three forms are allowed in classical Sanskrit too (भाषायामपि): उपेयुषः स्वामपि मूर्तिम् (Raghu).

quote.quote: उपपूर्वादिणो भाषायामपि भूतमात्रे लिड्वा तस्य नित्यं क्वसुः ।

gaps.what: What the option (वा) gives: the other past forms (लुङ् etc.) remain.
gaps.proposed_text: वा: the other past forms are equally right: उपागात्, उपैत्, उपेयाय; नाशीत्; अन्ववोचत्.

quote.quote: वावचनानुवृत्तेश्च पूर्ववल्लुङादयोऽपि भवन्ति। उपागात्। उपैत्। उपेयाय।

gaps.what: The इट् given by nipātana is only before a consonant: उपेयुषः (no इट् before a vowel).
gaps.proposed_text: The इट् of उपेयिवान् is not used before a vowel-ending: उपेयुषः, उपेयुषा.

quote.quote: तेनाजादौ न भवति। उपेयुषः। उपेयुषा।

3.2.109.ok: Each nipātana is analysed, and the teaching note on इट् in उपेयिवान् is accurate.

gaps.what: Which विद्: only ‘to know’ (ज्ञाने), not ‘to find’.
gaps.proposed_text: विदि = विद् ‘to know’ only, not विद् ‘to find’: विदुरः ‘wise’.

quote.quote: ज्ञानार्थस्य विदेः ग्रहणं न लाभार्थस्य  स्वभावात्।

gaps.what: Vārttika: व्यध् too takes कुरच्, with samprasāraṇa (विधुरः).
gaps.proposed_text: Vārttika: व्यध् also takes कुरच्, with samprasāraṇa: विधुरः.

quote.quote: व्यधेः संप्रसारणं कुरच्च वक्तव्यः॥ विधुरः॥

gaps.what: Examples incl. भिद्/छिद् used of the self-acting object (कर्मकर्तरि).
gaps.proposed_text: Examples: विदुरः पण्डितः, भिदुरं काष्ठम्, छिदुरा रज्जुः — भिद्, छिद् used of what breaks/splits by itself (कर्मकर्तरि).

quote.quote: विदुरः पण्डितः। भिदुरं काष्ठम्। छिदुरा रज्जुः। भिदिच्छिद्योः कर्मकर्तरि प्रयोगः॥

gaps.what: ‘Also at work’ still shows the uncorrected dhātu ‘भिदिँ अवयवे (gaṇa 1) … भिन्दतेः’, though the step says the audit corrected it to भिदिर् (रुधादि). Kaumudī-style vṛtti also has ‘प्रत्ययो स्यात्’ (must be प्रत्ययः स्यात्).
gaps.proposed_text: Drop the ‘भिन्दतेः’ line: भिदि = भिदिँर् विदारणे (रुधादि, भिनत्ति). Kaumudī style: ‘कुरच् प्रत्ययः स्यात्’.

quote.quote: विदादिभ्यो धातुभ्यः तच्छीलादिषु कर्तृषु कुरच् प्रत्ययो भवति।

3.2.162.ok: The three dhātus and the तच्छीलादि/वर्तमाने anuvṛtti shown correctly.

gaps.what: Vārttika: the replacement is OBLIGATORY when not agreeing with a 1st-case word; the option holds only in agreement with a प्रथमा. Page says only ‘optionally’.
gaps.proposed_text: वा is a fixed option (vyavasthita): obligatory when not in agreement with a प्रथमा — करिष्यन्तं पश्य; optional only with one: करिष्यन् / करिष्यति.

quote.quote: सद्विधिरप्रथमासमानाधिकरणे नित्यमिति वक्तव्यम्। पक्ष्यन्तं पश्य पक्ष्यमाणं पश्य। क्व तर्हीदानीं विभाषा? प्रथमासमानाधिकरणे।

gaps.what: सत् is the name given by 3.2.127 तौ सत् to शतृ and शानच्; not cited.
gaps.proposed_text: सत् = शतृ and शानच्, so named by 3.2.127 तौ सत्.

quote.quote: तौ शतृशानचौ सत्संज्ञौ भवतः।

gaps.what: Vṛtti number mismatch: ‘सत्सञ्ज्ञकौ आदेशः भवति’ (dual subject, singular verb).
gaps.proposed_text: Vṛtti: ‘… लृटः स्थाने सत्संज्ञौ शतृशानचौ वा भवतः’.

quote.quote: लृटः स्थाने सत्संज्ञौ शतृशानचौ वा भवतः।

3.3.14.ok: लृटः as sthānin and भविष्यति anuvṛtti well shown.

gaps.what: Card ‘कस्मिन् परे? / when what follows?’ for सपिण्डे, and step says 1.1.66 applies through it. The 7ths form a locative absolute (‘while another sapiṇḍa lives’); nothing follows.
gaps.proposed_text: सपिण्डे … जीवति is a locative absolute: ‘while another, senior sapiṇḍa is alive’. Not ‘when X follows’; 1.1.66 does not apply.

quote.quote: भ्रातुरन्यस्मिन् सपिण्डे स्थविरतरे जीवति पौत्रप्रभृतेरपत्यं जीवदेव युवसंज्ञं वा भवति।

gaps.what: Why अन्य, स्थविरतर, and the repeated जीवति (Bhāṣya padakṛtya); and the descendant himself must be alive (जीवदेव) — missing from the vṛtti.
gaps.proposed_text: अन्य: any sapiṇḍa, not only the brother (4.1.164). स्थविरतर: senior in BOTH rank and age. जीवति again: the descendant alive while the elder lives; once dead, only गार्ग्यः.

quote.quote: अन्यग्रहणं किमर्थम्? भ्रातरीति वर्तते, सपिण्डमात्रे यथा स्यात्। अथ स्थविरतरग्रहणं किमर्थम्? उभयतो विशिष्टे यथा स्यात्, स्थानतो वयस्तश्च।

gaps.what: सपिण्ड is not defined.
gaps.proposed_text: सपिण्ड = kin within seven generations: uncle, grandfather, elder brother. Then गर्ग's descendant may be गार्ग्यायणः (yuvan) or गार्ग्यः.

quote.quote: सप्तमपुरुषावधयः सपिण्डाः स्मर्यन्ते।

gaps.what: Vārttikas: yuvan-name for an elder in honour, gotra-name for a yuvan in contempt.
gaps.proposed_text: Vārttikas: honour → yuvan name for a gotra (तत्र भवान् गार्ग्यायणः); contempt → gotra name for a yuvan (गार्ग्यो जाल्मः).

quote.quote: गोत्रस्य युवसंज्ञा पूजायां गम्यमानायाम् । तत्र भवान्गार्ग्यायणः ।

4.1.165.ok: All five words read and the युवा/अपत्य/पौत्रप्रभृति anuvṛtti shown.

gaps.what: तस्मिन् = only the खञ् directly taught in 4.3.1, not the छ brought in by its च; hence युष्मदीयः.

quote.quote: सूतीति स्वरूपग्रहणम्। सुषूतिः। विषूतिः।

gaps.what: Order with reduplication: ṣatva before dvirvacana (8.2.1 not for dvitva) — सुषुषुपुः.
gaps.proposed_text: In perfect forms ṣatva comes before reduplication (पूर्वत्रासिद्धीयमद्विर्वचने): सुषुषुपुः.

quote.quote: <<पूर्वत्रासिद्धीयमद्विर्वचने>> इति कृते षत्वे ततो द्विर्वचनम्॥

8.3.88.ok: Prefixes, the three words and the मूर्धन्य/सः anuvṛtti shown.
